reference_method: Same independent convex-nerve count, with region/seam localization by winding signatures of explicitly covered nerve-cycle polygons
qualification_gate: For each face, retain exactly beta_1 independently free interior witnesses with distinct covered-cycle winding signatures. Match every free seam to one of those regions by a checked free segment. Only a complete face, witness and seam inventory may establish the global count.
known_before_reference: Runtime candidate at fixing source4fc2353 reports13 physical patches and10 native clusters. The reference must derive and verify its own answer; no expected13 acceptance constant. Retrospective characterization, not held out.
witness_discovery: Bounded convex primal/dual optimization may discover witnesses. Only independently checked point margins or convex lower bounds count as decisions; optimizer success alone is insufficient.
independence: No production DFND geometry routine, result or witness may be an input to reference generation/verification. Existing input codec and independent first_betti linear algebra may be reused.
scope: Fixed equal-radius shell/hull at0.05Å; no intrinsic mouth definition, aperture area or globally optimal bottleneck. Positive continuous paths are independently checked witnesses, not an exclusion of curved paths.

path_scope: Optional positive paths from the original origin are independently checked complete all-atom segments and exterior rays. Missing search success does not exclude curved paths and does not invalidate an independently complete global boundary count.
